text: Raina Telgemeier's Drama made the American Library Association's top 10 list of frequently challenged books in 2014 because of a ban at Chapel Hill Elementary School in Mount Pleasant, Texas. The book was claimed to be "sexually explicit" and was removed from the elementary school's library, while three copies remain in Chapel Hill Independent School District's combined middle/high school library. Drama also earned a spot on the ALA's list of the Top Ten Challenged Books for 2016, most likely because it was removed from a Texas junior high school for being "politically, racially, or socially offensive".
